turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
xpedited shipping does not speed up processing time.


It only affects the transit time after the order ships.


Expedited shipping operates on weekdays only (Monday–Friday).


Weekend delivery can’t be expedited.


Delivery estimates are not guaranteed, and expedited shipping fees are not refundable.



So if you need it sooner, the only faster option is to choose expedited shipping at checkout, but it won’t shorten the time before the order is processed and shipped.
